title: Hearty Uruguayan Chicken Wrap
description: A rich and crowd-pleasing Uruguayan dish featuring chicken, shio-cure, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, all wrapped in a lotus leaf. This dish is a perfect blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, chicken stock cube, shio-cure, and olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
Lay a lotus leaf flat on a work surface and spoon some cooked rice onto the center of the leaf.
Add the chicken mixture on top of the rice and fold the leaf over the filling to form a wrap.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 3 more wraps.
Bake the wraps in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Serve the wraps hot and enjoy.
